blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Marcos administration needs more than P4 billion to construct five of the 39 proposed rainwater impounding facilities in Metro Manila to address the perennial flooding problem in Metro Manila. The five projects have a combined indicative cost of about P4.05 billion, subject to the applicable government review, approval, budgeting and procurement processes, according to Executive Secretary Ralph Recto. Funding for these is proposed under the Disaster Rehabilitation and Reconstruction Assistance Program for Local Government Units of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Fund.
